newsitem.title: USA: Southern to provide Wellman power.
newsitem.headline: Southern to provide Wellman power.

text.p: Southern Co said Wednesday its Mississippi Power & Light Co subsidiary will provide 30 megawatts of electricity to the Wellman Co, a new Mississippi plastics manufacturer.
In early 1998, Wellman will begin manufacturing plastic beads used to make plastic bottles at a new facility in Bay St. Louis, Miss.

Southern said the agreement is the result of an innovative arrangement with South Mississippi Electric Power Association Southern Company will sell the electricity wholesale to SMEPA, which will resell it to Coast Electric Power Association, Wellman's retail electric service provider.
